options: A batch process that groups invoices across many suppliers
A single, immediate payment to one supplier created directly from an invoice
A type of credit memo
A report listing all overdue invoices
questions.explain: A quick payment bypasses batch selection and pays one supplier's invoice (or invoices) immediately.

questions.q: Which scenario is a good reason to use a quick payment instead of waiting for the next Payment Process Request?
options: Paying every routine monthly invoice for the entire supplier base
Running the regular weekly payment schedule
A rush invoice that must be paid today to unblock a held shipment
Paying all suppliers on a fixed net-30 term at month end
questions.explain: Quick payments are meant for urgent, one-off situations, not routine high-volume processing.

questions.q: What does a quick payment skip compared to the standard Payment Process Request flow?
options: The proposed-payment review step and batch file generation
The need to select a payment method
The requirement to specify an invoice
The need for a disbursement bank account
questions.explain: A quick payment processes immediately as its own transaction, without the review and file-generation steps a PPR goes through.

questions.q: In the Harbor Point Logistics example, why was a quick payment used instead of a standard PPR?
options: Because Harbor Point does not accept standard payment runs
Because quick payments are required for all international suppliers
Because the invoice amount exceeded the PPR's processing limit
Because the $4,200 invoice had to be paid the same day to release a held shipment
questions.explain: The urgency of releasing the shipment that day made waiting for the next scheduled payment run unacceptable.

questions.q: Why shouldn't quick payments be used as the default way to pay most invoices?
options: They are more expensive to process per Oracle's licensing
Using them for everything would defeat the efficiency benefit of batching invoices through a PPR
They can only be used once per fiscal year
They are not permitted for domestic suppliers
questions.explain: Quick payments trade batching efficiency for immediacy, so they're meant to stay an exception rather than the norm.
